relation.desc: ابن الصوة المقتول محمد بن حسن بن شعبان بن أبي بكر الباعوري
relation.note: D01737 (Ibn al-Dīwān) received the sultan's wakāla (Wakīl al-Sulṭān of the Aleppo lands) in succession to the murdered Ibn al-Ṣawwa = Muḥammad b. Ḥasan b. Shaʿbān b. Abī Bakr al-Bāʿūrī = AIND-D07349 (full biography, killed 20 Rajab 885 H). Confirmed by AIND-D12471 (the "Ibn al-Ṣawwa al-Maqtūl" entry), which states the wakāla passed from the murdered Ibn al-Ṣawwa to "Ibn al-Dīwān, who received it from his cousin," and then to the cousin Abū Bakr in place of Ibn al-Dīwān. Provisional TMP-P-000628 DISCARDED (existing AIND identified). NOTE: D07349 and D12471 appear to be a duplicate pair for the same murdered person — separate name-authority merge question, out of B11 scope.

person.note: アフマド・アッ＝シハーブ・イブン・アッ＝ディーワーン。アレッポのウスターダールを務めた後、イブン・アッ＝サウワの後任としてスルタン代理（ワキール・アッ＝スルターン）となった。894年ジュマーダー・アッ＝サーニー月9日にカイロで亡くなった。70歳を超えていた。父の名はアブー・バクル。

Aḥmad al-Shihāb b. al-Dīwān. He served as Ustādār of Aleppo, then as Wakīl al-Sulṭān in succession to Ibn al-Ṣawwa. He died in Cairo on the ninth of Jumādā al-Thāniya in the year 894 H, having passed seventy years of age. His father's name was Abū Bakr.
